# Prediabetes Pal

> Prediabetes Pal is a meal checker built only for prediabetes — for adults with an A1C between 5.7% and 6.4%. Describe a meal and get general meal-composition information, a cautious label, the reason behind it, and a practical alternative when there is one. Informational only; not medical advice.

Prediabetes Pal is not a calorie counter or a tracker. It answers one everyday question — what can I eat with prediabetes, at this meal, right now — with one calm read per meal. The first checks on day one are free, with no login and no card.

## Guides

- [Prediabetes guides index](https://prediabetespal.com/guides): plain-language guides for eating with prediabetes
- [A simple 7-day prediabetes meal plan](https://prediabetespal.com/guides/prediabetes-meal-plan): a week of ordinary meals built on the balanced-plate pattern
- [Healthy snacks for prediabetes](https://prediabetespal.com/guides/prediabetes-snacks): easy snack ideas and the pattern behind them
- [What to eat with prediabetes](https://prediabetespal.com/guides/what-to-eat-with-prediabetes): what you can eat freely, what is worth limiting, and breakfast
- [Prediabetes: now what?](https://prediabetespal.com/guides/prediabetes-now-what): calm first steps after an A1C of 5.7% to 6.4%
- [What an A1C of 5.7% to 6.4% means](https://prediabetespal.com/guides/a1c-5-7-to-6-4): how to read the number

## Pages

- [Check a meal](https://prediabetespal.com/check): describe a meal and get a cautious educational read on its balance
- [How it works](https://prediabetespal.com/how-it-works): what the weekly recap measures, the evidence behind it, and its honest limits
- [Pantry Review](https://prediabetespal.com/pantry): a calm read on the foods you keep at home
- [Pricing](https://prediabetespal.com/subscribe): what Premium includes and costs
- [Get the app](https://prediabetespal.com/get-the-app): install Prediabetes Pal on your phone
- [Privacy](https://prediabetespal.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://prediabetespal.com/terms)

## Boundaries

- Informational only — not medical advice, and never a substitute for a clinician.
- Prediabetes Pal describes general meal patterns; it does not predict any individual response.
- For A1C values outside the 5.7% to 6.4% range, Prediabetes Pal says so plainly and points to a clinician.
